description: This file defines an abstract class 'FileTransfer' in the Drupal core namespace, providing a base for file transfer operations on directories not writable by the webserver, such as via FTP or SSH. It includes properties, constructor, factory method, magic methods, and abstract methods for connecting, copying, creating, and deleting files/directories, with path sanitization and jail enforcement.

classes.name: FileTransfer
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for secure file transfer operations within Drupal, supporting backend connections like FTP or SSH, with jail restrictions and path handling.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a subclass of FileTransfer, must be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access 'connection' and 'chroot' properties, establishing connection if needed.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set 'connection' and 'chroot' properties.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if 'connection' or 'chroot' are set.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Magic method to unset 'connection' or 'chroot'.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Abstract method to establish a connection to the server.

methods.name: copyDirectory
methods.description: Copies a directory from source to destination within the jail.

methods.name: chmod
methods.description: Changes permissions of a file or directory, requires implementing ChmodInterface.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory at specified path.

methods.name: removeDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory at specified path.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specified file.

methods.name: checkPath
methods.description: Ensures a path is within the jail, throws exception if outside.

methods.name: fixRemotePath
methods.description: Sanitizes and adjusts paths for remote server compatibility, handling drive letters and chroot stripping.

methods.name: sanitizePath
methods.description: Converts Windows paths to POSIX and removes trailing slashes.

methods.name: copyDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Recursively copies directory contents, ensuring destination is within jail.

methods.name: createDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Abstract method to create directory within jail.

methods.name: removeDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Abstract method to remove directory within jail.

methods.name: copyFileJailed
methods.description: Abstract method to copy file within jail.

methods.name: removeFileJailed
methods.description: Abstract method to remove file within jail.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Abstract method to check if path is a directory.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Abstract method to check if path is a file.

methods.name: findChroot
methods.description: Determines chroot path by moving up directory tree.

methods.name: setChroot
methods.description: Sets chroot property and adjusts jail accordingly.

methods.name: getSettingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form for connection credentials, extendable by subclasses.
